the critical zeros of the family of even integral quadratic twists of a fixed elliptic curve are repelled from the critical line with a strength that depends on the size of the twists and that the critical zeros are distributed according to the one-level density (in the limit of large conductors) of a random-matrix ensemble with the characteristic polynomial of the matrices sieved-off.
the one-level density (and the other moments) of the excised orthogonal matrices are given by a formula involving the one-level density and other moments of the Jacobi ensemble.
